newsitem.title: USA: CACI teams with EDS for defense contract.
newsitem.headline: CACI teams with EDS for defense contract.

text.p: CACI International Inc said it will team with EDS Corp to support the Defense Finance and Accounting Service Financial Systems Organization Defense Financial Integrated Systems Services program (DFISS).

EDS has received one of four awards for DFISS, which is expected to have a total program value of $220 million. The indefinite delivery, indefinite quantity, time-and-materials prime contract consists of one base year plus four one-year options, with a five-year maximum duration, CACI said.
It said it anticipates starting work by mid-November.
DFISS has been developed to provide a broad scope of software development and technical services for over 200 Defense Finance and Accounting Service computer systems across the country.
